newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Markets over-reacted to Greenspan - BOE's George.
newsitem.headline: Markets over-reacted to Greenspan - BOE's George.

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Monday he believed markets over-reacted last week to comments by Federal Reserve Board chairman Alan Greenspan.
Asked whether financial markets over-reacted to comments last Thursday by Greenspan, George said: "I think they did initially, but they soon sorted themselves out."

Greenspan sent world financial markets tumbling last Friday when he said the central bnak needed to be wary when "irrational exuberance" infects stock and other asset markets because that could do damage to the economy.
George was queried about the Greenspan comments by reporters as he arrived at the Bank for International Settlements building for the monthly meeting of the G10 central bank governors.
